legalEntityId.description: The id of the legal entity to which customer is assigned.

count.description: The number of times a specific coupon has been redeemed in the context of the given legal entity.

redemptionCount.description: The number of times a specific coupon has been redeemed. Read-only, set through server. (seller-only).

deleted.description: Flag to mark a coupon as deleted (a.k.a. Soft delete). It is a read-only and seller-only attribute.

base-coupon.title: Coupon response/update payload
base-coupon.description: Coupons describe voucher alike commerce capabilities, e.g. 10% off winter accessories.

discountType.description: 'PERCENT' for relative values, 'ABSOLUTE' for float values, referring to a specific currency, 'FREE_SHIPPING' for reducing the shipping cost to 0.

discountPercentage.description: A discount percentage within the range [0.00, 100.00]. Must be specified only if type is 'PERCENT'.

discountAbsolute.description: Must be specified only if type is 'ABSOLUTE'. Defines the amount that should be substracted from the cart subtotal.

amount.description: Total amount in the specified currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g.: USD, EUR, CHF.

allowAnonymous.description: Specifies if the coupon can be redeemed by anonymous user. If set to false, only logged-in customers can redeem it.

maxRedemptionsPerCustomer.description: Maximum number of redemptions per customer; -1 designates 'unlimited'. Cannot be specified for coupons which can be redeemed by anonymous users.

discountCalculationType.description: Determines whether the coupon is applied to the total or subtotal value of the order.

issuedTo.description: The Id of the customer who originally received the coupon (seller-only).

version.description: Version of the document. Set to 0 after creating a document. Increments by 1 after every update.

categoryRestricted.description:
Defines if the coupon has category restrictions.
***
Info: Cannot be combined together with the segment restrictions.

currency-amount.title: Money amount
currency-amount.description: Defines an amount in a specific currency.

amount.description: Total amount in the specified currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g.: USD, EUR, CHF.

referralCouponProperty.description: Indicates if the coupon is type of referral coupon. This property is read only.

validFor.description: A list of customer identifiers for whom the coupon can be redeemed. Cannot be specified for coupons which can be redeemed by anonymous users.

validFrom.description: Must be provided in ISO 8601 format (http://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/iso8601.htm), e.g. '2015-01-31T23:59:59.999Z'.

validUntil.description: Must be provided in ISO 8601 format (http://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/iso8601.htm), e.g. '2015-01-31T23:59:59.999Z'.

allOf.description: The minimum order value required to use the coupon. When `vendorRestricted` is `true`, this value is checked against the total of the matching vendor items.

includedCategories.description: The list of product's categories to which this coupon applies to. Must be defined only if the `categoryRestricted` flag is set to true. Must be disjoint with excludedCategories list.

excludedCategories.description: The list of product's categories to which this coupon does not apply to. Can be defined only if the `categoryRestricted` flag is set to true. Must be disjoint with includedCategories list.

segments.description: The list of segments to which this coupon applies to. Can be defined only if the `segmentRestricted` flag is set to true.

vendors.description: The list of vendor identifiers to which this coupon applies. Must be provided when `vendorRestricted` is `true`, and must be empty when `vendorRestricted` is `false`.

segmentRestricted.description:
Defines if the coupon has segment restrictions. If the value is set to `true`, the `restrictions.segments` must be provided.
***
Info: Cannot be combined neither with the category restrictions nor with customers restrictions.

vendorRestricted.description:
Defines if the coupon applies only to products from specific vendors. If the value is `true`, `restrictions.vendors` must be provided.
A vendor restriction can be combined with other restriction types.
